cmqwkgii506zpnwqopom30pq3.entry: You need a completed high-school diploma — or, instead, one of the national or international exams listed in the annex of Yeditepe's International Student Admission Guidelines. The diploma must show the grade average out of 100, or a formal document with the average must be added. Diploma minimums are set per country (for example 60% for Egypt, Jordan, Iraq, Pakistan, Syria and Attestat countries; 75% or 2.8/4 for a US high-school diploma; 80% for the UAE). Applications are evaluated on exam scores, grade averages, references and the letter of intent (guidelines dated August 2024).
cmqwkgii506zpnwqopom30pq3.language: An English certificate is not required to apply. TOEFL iBT 79 (or 4 on the 1-6 scale) or YDS/e-YDS/YÖKDİL/e-YÖKDİL 66, taken within the last two years, exempts you from the English Proficiency Exam; TOEFL scores must be sent directly by ETS (institution code 7050). IELTS and TOEFL Home Edition are not accepted. Otherwise you take the university's English Proficiency Exam (pass 60/100) or the English Preparatory Program (up to two years).
